أَعْقَصُ A goat (S, O, Msb, K) or sheep (Msb) whose horns are twisted, or contorted, upon his ears, (S, O, Msb, K,) backwards: (S, O, K:) fem. عَقْصَآءُ: (Msb:) or عَقْصَآءُ القَرْنِ signifies a شَاة [i. e. sheep or goat] having a twisting, or contortion, in the horn: (A:) and ↓ مِعْقَاصٌ , a sheep or goat crooked in the horn. (K.) ―
-b2- Also Having the fingers twisting, one upon another. (Ibn- 'Abbád, O, K.) ―
-b3- And Whose central incisors enter into his mouth, (O, K, TA,) and are twisted. (TA.) ―
-b4- See also عَقِصٌ, last sentence.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
